user.title: Set up CheckBaby
user.description: One entry per child. You can set this up before the birth: enter the expected due date and correct it later.

data.birth_date: Birth date or expected due date

data_description.child_name: Used for the device, its entities and the notifications.
data_description.birth_date: Sets the age profile, which decides which alerts apply (prone position, leaving the bed).

place.title: Sleep place
place.description: Where the child sleeps, with its camera and sensors. A sound source is required: a Frigate camera with audio detection, or a crying sensor. Everything else is optional. More sleep places can be added later.

data.name: Name of the sleep place
data.person_is_caregiver: A person seen by the camera counts as a caregiver

data_description.frigate_camera: The camera's name in the Frigate configuration. Crying, sound level and motion are read from Frigate over MQTT.
data_description.camera_entity: Used for the picture in notifications and for the AI assessment.
data_description.bed_zone: If set, a cat or dog detected in this zone raises a warning.
data_description.door_entity: While the door is open someone is with the child and child-related alerts pause.
data_description.person_is_caregiver: Leave off if Frigate detects the child itself as a person.
data_description.presence_entity: On while the child is in bed, for example a zone of a presence radar.
data_description.breath_rate_entity: Breaths per minute, for example from a 60 GHz radar sensor. Used for the breathing-movement hint.
data_description.engine_id: Only with the CheckBaby vital engine: the ID configured there.
data_description.audio_stream_url: Played on the parents' speaker by the audio relay, for example an audio stream from go2rtc.
data_description.cry_entity: Alternative to Frigate, for example the crying detection of the camera itself.

notify.title: Who is told
notify.description: Choose the phones that receive alerts and, if you have one, a local alarm that works without internet. At least one of the two is required.

data_description.notify_services: Notify services of the Home Assistant companion app. Critical alerts go to all of them.
data_description.local_alarm_entities: Switched on when an alert stays unanswered for a minute, or at once if the internet is down. Put it where you sleep, never in the child's room.

disclaimer.title: What CheckBaby is, and what it is not
disclaimer.description: CheckBaby is not a medical device. It cannot prevent sudden infant death and it can fail without warning. It supports your supervision and the rules for safe infant sleep; it does not replace either. Keep a simple baby monitor as a fallback.

data.acknowledged: I have read and understood this

error.no_sound_source: Enter a Frigate camera or choose a crying sensor: without a sound source the monitor cannot hear the child.
error.no_alert_target: Choose at least one phone or a local alarm; otherwise no alert could reach anyone.
error.ai_consent_required: Confirm that images may be sent, or remove the AI tasks.

abort.already_configured: A child with this name is already set up.

init.title: CheckBaby options
init.description: Who is told, and what else is connected. Sleep places are managed as separate entries of the child.

data.ai_task_entities: AI tasks, in order of preference
data.ai_consent: Images of the child may be sent to these AI tasks
data.ai_calls_per_hour: AI calls per hour at most

data_description.notify_services: Notify services of the Home Assistant companion app. Critical alerts go to all of them.
data_description.local_alarm_entities: Switched on when an alert stays unanswered for a minute, or at once if the internet is down. Put it where you sleep, never in the child's room.
data_description.babysitter_service: Receives alerts only while the mode is “Babysitter”.
data_description.heartbeat_buttons: Pressed every 30 seconds while monitoring is armed and healthy, so that a separate device can sound when Home Assistant fails.
data_description.smoke_entities: Passed through as critical alerts, even while monitoring is off.
data_description.internet_entity: While it is off, the local alarm fires at once.
data_description.ai_task_entities: The first one that answers is used. A cloud model receives camera images of the child; a local model keeps them at home.
data_description.ai_consent: Required to use the AI assessment. Check your provider's terms on how images are used.

error.no_alert_target: Choose at least one phone or a local alarm; otherwise no alert could reach anyone.
error.ai_consent_required: Confirm that images may be sent, or remove the AI tasks.
